item.title: US Representative Introduces Plan To Preserve Digital Game Ownership
item.description: United States Representative Ritchie Torres will introduce the Power To The Players Act . This legislation is being made to support consumers' rights in a way that grants gamers ownership of their digital games. If successful, the Federal Trade Commission could then establish regulations to prevent companies from delisting games, shutting down servers early in a game's life, and easily revoking digital licenses.

item.title: 22 Years Ago, One Perfect Twist Changed TV's Greatest Sci-Fi Series Forever
item.description: At the time, Lindelof was discussing his new series, Lost — which just four episodes in, had pulled off a mind-blowing twist arguably on the same level as The Sixth Sense . For its first few episodes, Lost seems like an ambitious survival drama with a dash of horror. Oceanic Flight 815 crashes on a seemingly deserted tropical island. Its survivors contend with dwindling supplies, a rampaging monster, an inexplicable polar bear, and the unfortunate realization that rescuers are probably searching a thousand miles away from where they actually crashed.

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company Finally Makes Starting A New Campaign Worth It
item.description: I've been waiting for a reason to start a new playthrough of Star Wars Zero Company ever since I beat the game in early September. EA and Bit Reactor have finally given me a reason to come back to the game, as Patch 1.2 added a lot of new gameplay settings that will allow me to tweak my next playthrough's difficulty to my liking.

item.title: Analogue Brings Back Its Perfect SNES And Sega Genesis Replacements
item.description: As original hardware ages, playing retro games becomes less practical for many reasons. Analogue strives to keep retro games alive by providing modern hardware capable of running games that are decades old. It did so with the launch of the Super Nt and Mega Sg in 2017 and 2019, respectively. If you missed out on these systems back then, you now have another chance to acquire them with the release of their upgraded versions: the Super Nt+ and the Mega Sg+.

item.title: 2026 Has Been a Surprisingly Excellent Year for Shooters
item.description: All the way back in January, it seemed like 2026 might be a rough year for fans of shooters. Highguard ’s launch and almost immediate delaunch created an anxiety around the genre that was hard to shake. Scrutiny around Marathon in the lead-up to its launch doubled that uncertainty, leaving some to wonder if the shooter genre — at least in its trusty live-service form — was going out of fashion.

item.title: The Best Transformers Movie That No One Watched Finds New Life on Streaming
item.description: Under director Michael Bay, Paramount built a billion-dollar franchise across five live-action Transformers movies . But after Bay's final turn behind the camera, 2017's Transformers: The Last Knight , the robots-in-disguise franchise started to go in unpredictable new directions. The 2018 prequel Bumblebee was, unlike Bay's films, a critical and commercial hit, though it didn't hit the billion-dollar highs of earlier films. 2023's Transformers: Rise of the Beasts failed to turn the franchise around the way Paramount hoped.

item.title: Early Modern Warfare 4 Consensus Unanimous That It Features On Of The Best COD Campaigns Ever
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign released on Oct. 16 for those who pre-ordered the game digitally, so first reactions to it are finally rolling in. So far, sentiment around this part of the new Call of Duty is positive, with many fans praising the campaign.

item.title: The 8 Best Vampire Books Not Written by Anne Rice
item.description: In vampire stories, the immortal creatures of the night often trace their lineage back centuries. The authors of these stories are themselves part of a creative bloodline that took myths about blood-sucking monsters and turned them into timeless stories of horror . The genre’s foundations were laid by Sheridan Le Fanu's 1872 novella Carmilla and Bram Stoker’s 1897 novel Dracula , but Anne Rice is the undisputed master of the modern vampire story.

item.title: Netflix’s 'Dealies' Will Be a More Comedy-Focused Joe Bennet Series
item.description: Joe Bennet’s next animated series is shaping up to be a little different from his previous work on Scavengers Reign and Common Side Effects . The upcoming Netflix series Dealies will focus on the strange characters working at a big-box store, with an antique shop across the street providing some competition.
